pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Thousand-Year Spirit Wood Heart is a rare treasure associated with the accumulated essence of ancient trees. Over generations, spiritual energy is believed to gather within their inner wood, forming a dense and enduring core. Such treasures are most often found in forests that have remained undisturbed for ages.

pages.title: Where to Find
pages.text: Old-growth pine, spruce, and birch forests, dark forests, and jungles.
